# VictorStack: engineering notes by Victor Jimenez

> Victor Jimenez is a Senior Product Engineer with 13+ years of full-stack web development. This blog holds his engineering notes on React, Next.js, TypeScript, PHP, Node and Python, integrations, release engineering, performance, security and accessibility.

## About the author

- Name: Victor Jimenez
- Role: Senior Product Engineer
- Work: full-stack web products from the browser to the database
- Focus areas: architecture and integrations (payments and billing, OAuth and SSO, CRM), CI/CD and release verification, performance and technical SEO, security and accessibility, AI-assisted engineering and automation, technical leadership
- Specialties: Drupal and WordPress

## How posts are written

- Posts dated before October 2026 were drafted by an automated content pipeline. They were reviewed in October 2026: posts with claims that could not be verified were removed, and low-value posts were unlisted.
- Posts dated October 2026 or later are written and approved by Victor.

## Topics

- Architecture, APIs and integrations
- Release engineering, CI/CD and testing
- Performance and technical SEO
- Security and accessibility
- AI engineering and agent workflows
- Drupal and WordPress
